Termio.terminal: Terminal (src/terminal/Terminal.zig)
|
|-- Geometry: rows / cols / pixel dimensions / scrolling_region / tabstops
|-- Protocol/session state: modes / colors / title / pwd / mouse flags
|-- Terminal-level cursor state (screen coordinates live in Screen.cursor)
|-- screens: ScreenSet (src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig)
|   |-- all: owned Screen pointers; primary eager, alternate lazy
|   |   `-- Screen (src/terminal/Screen.zig)
|   |       |-- cursor: coordinates / style / pending_wrap / hyperlink state
|   |       |   `-- page_pin / page_row / page_cell -> current page storage
|   |       |-- saved_cursor / selection
|   |       |-- charset / protected_mode / kitty_keyboard
|   |       |-- kitty_images / semantic_prompt / dirty
|   |       `-- pages: PageList (src/terminal/PageList.zig)
|   |           |-- pages: ordered linked list, history through active screen
|   |           |   `-- Node: links / serial / backing-memory ownership tag
|   |           |       |-- resident: Page (src/terminal/page.zig)
|   |           |       |   |-- memory: contiguous page-aligned backing block
|   |           |       |   |-- rows: ordered row metadata
|   |           |       |   |-- cells: rows locate column-ordered cell spans
|   |           |       |   |-- styles: page-local style set
|   |           |       |   `-- Grapheme and hyperlink maps / string storage
|   |           |       `-- OR compressed: encoded copy + retained Page mapping
|   |           |-- tracked_pins: maintained viewport / cursor / selection pins
|   |           |-- viewport: active / top / pin; preallocated viewport_pin
|   |           `-- Scrollback limits / total_rows / dimensions / compression state
|   |-- active + active_key: alias into all, not a separately owned Screen
|   `-- generations: distinguish replaced screen storage
|-- resize() -> Screen/PageList geometry and reflow
|-- StreamHandler operations -> mutate this Terminal and its active Screen
|-- Renderer -> samples viewport/cells/dirty state under Surface mutex
`-- deinit() -> ScreenSet destroys Screens -> Screen releases PageList storage
